design_changes: Stop selling 'label-exact' on product-in-scene stills (table stakes: Google free in BR, Pebblely US$9, Mokker US$13, Pixelcut US$10, Photoroom US$12,99). New differentiator: 'Fotos com o produto em uso e um filme em movimento - a IA cria as mãos, a pele, o cenário e a luz; a sua embalagem nunca passa por ela. Campanha completa, num só universo visual, em 5 a 7 dias úteis.'

Guarantee rewrite: 'em nenhuma foto e em nenhum quadro do filme a IA inventa, troca ou deforma uma letra, o logo ou a forma da sua embalagem, e a cor fica dentro da tolerância aprovada na ficha; se falhar, refazemos sem custo em até 2 dias úteis. Partes podem ficar escondidas pela mão/ângulo/foco conforme o key visual aprovado - escondidas, nunca alteradas.'

Report rewrite: compare the pack pixel-by-pixel (film: frame-by-frame) against the client-approved MASTER image; OCR-check only legible text against the PDF. Drop 'Lista de ativos OK' from the sample unless it is actually legible and checked.
Define a colour tolerance and the occlusion rule on the ficha the client signs; otherwise integration grading breaks the 'Cor OK' promise.

Confidentiality rewrite: 'Sua arte e suas fotos nunca são enviadas a um gerador de imagens nem a nenhum serviço online de IA: o trabalho com a embalagem é feito no nosso computador.' Ops rule: Photoshop Select Subject/Remove Background on Device (the default), never Cloud; no Generate Background/Harmonize/Generative Fill on the pack layer; Higgsfield only sees the blank placeholder.
PRÉVIA must be an in-hand / in-use shot (the thing cutout tools cannot do label-exact), never product-on-surface (free at Google/Pebblely/Villo).
VITRINE: keep R$490 only if it includes >=2 in-use/in-hand shots and is sold as 'same world as your launch'; otherwise fold it into O LANÇAMENTO as an add-on.

Film: state 'movimento de câmera e luz sobre a sua embalagem; giro completo não incluso'. Optional 360-degree insert via Pacdora Business (US$59/mo, commercial and resale licence) for template shapes, after a test of shape match and alpha export.

Master-image sourcing for pre-launch SKUs (0/15 had a public photo): phone photo of a physical sample, OR a Pacdora render from the PDF (makes 'idêntico à arte' literally true), OR a one-off 3D model kept as part of the 'world on file'.

R$0 test before the first call: the founder runs the same bestseller tube through Pixelcut Product Studio On Model and Photoroom free tiers; if either keeps the label exact with a hand over it, in-hand scarcity falls, and only motion-in-world + coherence + speed + guarantee + service remain.
residual_risks: No technology moat: the composite method is published (Lamina, Higgsfield's own brand-asset recipe composites logos); Criativoo already sells a CGI+IA label-exact hybrid to Brazilian indie cosmetics; any brand designer with Pacdora + Pixelcut can approach it. The position is price, speed and service between self-serve (R$0-300) and CGI (R$3.990 in 20-40 working days), not a moat.
Pixelcut's 'fixed product' claim may extend to on-model/in-hand shots (UNVERIFIED) - if true, the in-hand gap closes.
Photoroom's Enterprise Guarantee (launched 1 Sep 2026, beauty listed as an industry) could move down-market.
O LANÇAMENTO cannot do a full product rotation; CGI studios and Pacdora can, label-exact.
Pacdora: template shape mismatch, alpha export and training policy all UNVERIFIED; uploading unreleased art to its cloud weakens the confidentiality line.
Small text cannot be OCR-verified at campaign scale; the report must not claim it.
Untouched: the separate price-evidence problem (observed buyer budgets < US$500).
